# Enhanced residuals vs fitted plot (deprecated)

<small>Source: [`R/plotDiagnostics.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/plotDiagnostics.R) · Help: `?plotResidualsFittedEnhanced`</small>

Deprecated since 0.14.0: use `plotResidualsFitted(model, enhanced = TRUE)`,
which draws the same plot. This name still works and warns.

## Usage

```r
plotResidualsFittedEnhanced(model)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted model of class `lm`.

## Value

A `ggplot` object.
